Meta.description: Read webtoons, manga and manhwa published by their authors and teams. Rate, review and share your lists.

Accueil.accroche: Series published by their authors and teams, built to be read one-handed on your phone.

atouts.titre: What you will be able to do here

lire.texte: Vertical scrolling for webtoons, page by page for manga. Your position is remembered.

suivre.texte: A notification for every new chapter: on the site, on your phone or by email.

partager.texte: Half-star ratings, reviews, public or private lists and a reading diary.
